Master §49 Crash-Consistency Rule forbids silent success on a partial barrier; the typed error from commit() is the only honest return value. The fix enforces §49 by ensuring any index-key failure aborts the batch and surfaces Err(BatchAborted) on commit. NO production change at master plan level.

C6 Guard Precedence at append_event.rs:18-26 lists 8 guards but only 7 are coded. The fix adds G8 IndexKeyConstruction with aborted=true on Err. Doc-comment must be updated to enumerate G8 alongside G1..G7. Tested by batch_index_key_error_aborts_commit pattern.

Cross-method invariant: every fallible step in JournalWriteBatch sets self.aborted = true before propagating the typed error. put_* methods honor this (28 occurrences in putters.rs); append_event violates it for the G8 path. The fix restores parity.

append_event.rs:119 inserts the key into staged_event_keys AFTER the index-op `?`. If G8 fires, the key is not in the set, so a follow-up same-key append re-passes G1+G2 and only fails at G3 (durable lookup). Decision: independent question, flag for downstream contract owner. May require moving the insert to before G8 for full abort consistency.
